name: publicWeb_getGlobalRuns
description: Returns one row per run across all kennels for the hashruns.org global Runs tab. Unlike publicWeb_getGlobalCalendar (one row per kennel per day), this returns individual runs with full kennel and event detail so the detail panel needs no second call. Upcoming = EventStartDatetimeGmt within the last 8 hours or later; past = before ISNULL(@MaxEventDate, now) and, when given, EventStartDatetime >= @MinEventDate. Only visible, live runs of live kennels. Offset paging: the page is chosen on keys in a CTE and the wide columns are joined for that page only (2026-10-08, after the full-width sort spilled to tempdb); OPTION (RECOMPILE). No authentication. Read-only. Since 2026-10-13 sorting and the @MinEventDate filter use COALESCE(EventStartDateTimeGmt, EventStartDatetime), the true instant (was raw EventStartDatetime: 48 misordered pairs in the next 60 runs).

parameters.name: IsFuture
parameters.description: 1 = upcoming (EventStartDatetimeGmt >= now − 8 h), 0 = past. No SQL default.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Rows per page; default 50; NULL, < 1 or > 5000 → 50. The home page asks for 5000 to load every upcoming run in one SSR request.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Zero-based row offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: MinEventDate
parameters.description: Past only: inclusive lower bound, compared with the RAW EventStartDatetime (see codeSmells). NULL = all history.

parameters.name: MaxEventDate
parameters.description: Past only: exclusive upper bound compared with EventStartDatetimeGmt. NULL = now.

rowsets.name: TotalCount
rowsets.description: Always exactly one row: the count of runs matching the filter before paging, so the client can compute hasMore.

columns.name: TotalMatchingEvents
columns.description: Total events matching the IsFuture filter before the PageSize cap is applied.

rowsets.name: GlobalRuns
rowsets.description: One page of runs (OFFSET @Offset FETCH @PageSize), ORDER BY the RAW EventStartDatetime ASC (upcoming) or DESC (past), then KennelName, then PublicEventId as stable tiebreakers. Empty when nothing matches.

columns.name: PublicEventId
columns.description: HC.Event.PublicEventId — public-facing event UUID for deep-links.

columns.name: EventNumber
columns.description: HC.Event.EventNumber — kennel-scoped run number.

columns.name: EventName
columns.description: HC.Event.EventName — event name. Table column NOT NULL.

columns.name: EventStartDatetime
columns.description: CAST(Event.EventStartDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — timezone offset stripped. Client receives local time without UTC offset. Use KennelIANATimezone to reconstruct the offset if needed.

columns.name: PackOffMinutes
columns.description: Effective pack-off (E3.F1.S6): minutes after the gather — the run's own, else the kennel's default; NULL = the pack leaves at the gather.

columns.name: EventEndDatetime
columns.description: CAST(Event.EventEndDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — timezone offset stripped. NULL when no end time is set.

columns.name: EventStartDatetimeGmt
columns.description: COALESCE(HC.Event.EventStartDatetimeGmt, AT TIME ZONE fallback from the kennel's city timezone) — the UTC instant.

columns.name: KennelIANATimezone
columns.description: IANA zone of the kennel's city: the territory '001' mapping, else MIN(IANATimeZone) for the Windows zone. NULL when unmapped.

columns.name: EventTypeName
columns.description: DomainValues.EventThemeType.EventEnumName — human-readable event theme type (e.g. 'Red Dress Run'). NULL when Event.ThemeRunType has no matching DomainValues row (ThemeRunType = 0 = normal run).

columns.name: EventPriceForMembers
columns.description: COALESCE(Event.EventPriceForMembers, Kennel.DefaultEventPriceForMembers) — event-level price overrides kennel default. NULL when neither is set.

columns.name: EventPriceForNonMembers
columns.description: COALESCE(Event.EventPriceForNonMembers, Kennel.DefaultEventPriceForNonMembers) — event-level price overrides kennel default. NULL when neither is set.

columns.name: EventCurrencyType
columns.description: COALESCE(Event.EventCurrencyType, Kennel.DefaultEventCurrencyType) — currency code (e.g. 'USD'). NULL when neither is set.

columns.name: Hares
columns.description: HC.Event.Hares — free-text hare names. Table column is NVARCHAR(2500) NULL.

columns.name: LocationOneLineDesc
columns.description: HC.Event.LocationOneLineDesc — one-line human-readable location.

columns.name: LocationStreet
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLocationStreet — computed column (LocationStreet or FbLocationStreet depending on UseFbLocation).

columns.name: LocationCity
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLocationCity — computed column.

columns.name: LocationPostCode
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLocationPostCode — computed column.

columns.name: LocationRegion
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLocationRegion — computed column.

columns.name: LocationCountry
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLocationCountry — computed column.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLatitude — computed column (Latitude or FbLatitude depending on UseFbLatLon). Table column type DECIMAL(18,15) NULL.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncLongitude — computed column. Table column type DECIMAL(19,15) NULL.

columns.name: w3wJson
columns.description: HC.Event.w3wJson — what3words JSON ('map' URL and/or 'words').

columns.name: EventDescription
columns.description: HC.Event.SyncDescription — EventDescription or FbEventDescription depending on UseFbRunDetails (the generic import mirror).

columns.name: EventImage
columns.description: HC.Event.EventImage — URL of the event image. NULL when not set.

columns.name: EventUrl
columns.description: HC.Event.EventUrl — external event page URL.

columns.name: Tags1
columns.description: HC.Event.Tags1 — raw bitflag integer for event tags set 1. Decoded client-side.

columns.name: Tags2
columns.description: HC.Event.Tags2 — raw bitflag integer for event tags set 2. Decoded client-side.

columns.name: Tags3
columns.description: HC.Event.Tags3 — raw bitflag integer for event tags set 3. Decoded client-side.

columns.name: IsCountedRun
columns.description: HC.Event.IsCountedRun — whether this run counts toward run totals. SMALLINT NOT NULL.

columns.name: KennelSlug
columns.description: URL slug. Used to build run permalinks (/{slug}/{eventNumber}) and kennel page links (/{slug}).

columns.name: KennelShortName
columns.description: Kennel.KennelShortName.

columns.name: KennelName
columns.description: Full kennel name for display in the list card and detail panel.

columns.name: KennelLogo
columns.description: Kennel.KennelLogo as stored (may be 'bundle://defaultKennelLogo' — not NULLIFed here, unlike publicWeb_getMultiKennelRuns). Caller must verify an https:// prefix before rendering.

columns.name: PrimaryColor
columns.description: CSS hex colour used for kennel name text and logo placeholder background in the list.

columns.name: AccentColor
columns.description: Secondary accent colour for the kennel. Used for row labels and section headings in the detail panel.

columns.name: PublicKennelId
columns.description: Public kennel GUID.

columns.name: KennelWebsiteDomain
columns.description: The kennel's custom domain (e.g. 'www.cityhash.org'). NULL for kennels without a custom domain. Used for the 'Open Kennel website' button and fourth QR code — omit both when NULL.

columns.name: KennelContinent
columns.description: Continent name from HC.Country via Kennel.CountryId. NULL when the kennel has no country set. Used for search/filter.

columns.name: SearchTags
columns.description: Free-text search keywords for the run, flattened from Kennel.KennelSearchTags, City.CitySearchTags, Region.RegionSearchTags and Country.CountrySearchTags with commas replaced by spaces. Carries terms the geographic hierarchy cannot express - notably 'Scotland', which is neither a Country nor a Region row, so Scottish kennels are only findable by that word through this column. Empty string when nothing is tagged.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: @IsFuture have no SQL default (line 2). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.
The CATCH (line 259) logs HcVersion '<unknown>' where the newer public-web SPs write '<web>'.
Lines 221-226 concatenate four NVARCHAR(4000) tag columns; the result is typed NVARCHAR(4000) and anything beyond is cut without error. Tags are short today.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never remove Rowset 0 — callers rely on TotalMatchingEvents to compute hasMore
Never change the sort order within a tab — callers rely on stable pagination
